# Career Outcomes of Work-Family Conflict: A Literature Review and Future Research Agenda

**Authors:** Y. Jiang, Z. Jiang, X. Zheng, Chia-Huei Wu  
**Year:** 2026  
**Journal:** Journal of Vocational Behavior  
**DOI:** [10.1016/j.jvb.2025.103892](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jvb.2025.103892)

**Keywords:** work-family conflict, career outcomes, literature review, work-life interface, career development

## Abstract

A comprehensive literature review examining how work-family conflict affects career outcomes, identifying key mechanisms and proposing a future research agenda for understanding the long-term career consequences of work-life conflict.
